Messages.Author: Bloodartist
Messages.Body:
Does  secure haven prevent  Alexis Sorokin from stealing an equipment from the vampire with secure haven?

Alexis' ability is a directed action, but it doesn't state what is the actual target.. Just the equipment itself or the vampire who Alexis is stealing from?

Smoking craters tell no tales.
—Tex talks Battletech

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> Bloodartist wrote:
> Does  secure haven prevent  Alexis Sorokin from stealing an equipment from the vampire with secure haven?
>
No. Stealing an equipment from a minion doesn't target that minion.

> Bloodartist wrote:
> Alexis' ability is a directed action, but it doesn't state what is the actual target.. Just the equipment itself or the vampire who Alexis is stealing from?
>
Text is: "She may steal an equipment card as a  action." What is stolen? The equipment card.

The only exception is blood: taking an action that affects (steal, burn...) blood (or tokens) from a vampire targets the vampire itself.

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body: Correct. Similarly, burning a location on a minion (for instance : Arson on someone's Secure Haven) isn't a  action against that minion, but against the location.
